intent: Inspect and refactor ReorderHistoryService without changing the ast_hints surface or the tests' behavior (never seal or finalize a type another unit stubs; no magic numbers, no blocking calls, no raw logger calls beyond the claimed step logs). Unit contract: Context Telemetry Stream Processing & History use case (consumes TelemetrySampleValidated/ValidationFailed from the in-process stream). handle(event): sample = event.sample(); latest = repository.findLatestTDevice(deviceId, metric); id = repository.appendSample(sample). Dedup identity (deviceId, metric, tDevice): when appendSample is EMPTY the sample is a retry of an already stored one (on_empty): do nothing more, no revision, no event - at-least-once safe. Otherwise lateness = Duration between sample.tDevice() and sample.tIngress(): if lateness is greater than properties.reorderWindow() the sample is late beyond the Backfill Reorder Window -> repository.appendRevision(id, RevisionReason.BACKFILL, value, tIngress), meters.revisionAppended, log 'revision appended', audit APPEND_REVISION SUCCESS, publish HistoryEvent REVISION_APPENDED with the revision number; else if latest exists and is after sample.tDevice() the sample is an out-of-order arrival re-indexed by tDevice (never by tIngress) -> meters.sampleReordered, log 'sample reordered within backfill window', publish HistoryEvent SAMPLE_BACKFILLED (revisionNo 0). Then read the window with repository.findWindow(deviceId, metric, tDevice minus reorderWindow, tDevice, properties.reorderBufferCapacity()), log 'window buffered', publish HistoryEvent WINDOW_BUFFERED with windowSize = rows read and audit BROADCAST_WINDOW SUCCESS. On any failure after the append: audit the failing action with outcome FAILURE and propagate the error. Audit actor 'history-service', correlationId from the event, timestamp clock.instant(); meters.recordLatency('history', elapsed). Invalid (VALIDATION_FAILED) payloads are stored like any other. No blocking, no .subscribe(). Owns the step logs 'sample reordered within backfill window', 'revision appended', 'window buffered'. Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration. Reached from PipelineSubscriber.
